attributes.mlflow.spanOutputs:
{"sql_query": "SELECT
  C.CategoryName AS category,
  SUM(OD.Quantity) AS quantity
FROM Orders AS O
JOIN "Order Details" AS OD
  ON O.OrderID = OD.OrderID
JOIN Products AS P
  ON OD.ProductID = P.ProductID
JOIN Categories AS C
  ON P.CategoryID = C.CategoryID
WHERE
  O.OrderDate BETWEEN '1997-06-21' AND '1997-09-22'
GROUP BY
  C.CategoryName
ORDER BY
  quantity DESC
LIMIT 1;"}

FROM Orders AS O

JOIN Products AS P
  ON OD.ProductID = P.ProductID

WHERE

GROUP BY
  C.CategoryName
ORDER BY
  quantity DESC
